method.tool: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel (target=production, name=proklinator-static, teamId omitted)
method.description: build.mjs fetches the 59 site files (2494290 B) from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, 3 attempts per source, 8 in flight) at the pinned commit 906c90e and aborts with exit 1 unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public. The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit; this is the same pattern as the v20, v20.1 and v20.2 deploys. The manifest was generated from the pinned commit's git blobs (HEAD == origin/main == 906c90e, clean tree, blobs cross-checked against the working tree) and the script was dry-run locally before deploying (59/59 files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com and byte-identical to the checkout, no extraneous output files) together with a negative test (one tampered hash -> the build aborts with exit 1). The Vercel build finished in about a minute; the raw deployment URL served the verified v20.3 index at 10:16:50Z and the public alias followed at 10:17:01Z.

notes: The repository is public (gh: visibility PUBLIC), which is what makes the pinned-commit fetch possible; the ~2.5 MB site tree (59 files, 2494290 B) was therefore not inlined into the MCP request.
Git-linked auto-deploy was not used, for the same reasons as before: create_git_project requires teamId (the 403 trigger) and cannot re-link the existing unlinked project proklinator-static.

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploys; no 403 occurred. Team-scoped read endpoints (get_deployment requires teamId and returns 404 'Deployment not found' for this token even with the known team id) were not usable, so the build was followed and verified over HTTP against the raw deployment URL and the public alias.
The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/SSO/protection settings were touched. Registration and payments were not opened.

ATTRIBUTIONS.md was optional for this deploy and was included (5662 B, text/markdown) because the self-hosted Lucide SVGs are ISC-licensed and the attribution file is the natural companion on the same origin; README.md, DEPLOY_RESULT.json and docs/ stay out of the deployment as before.
The eight category icons are inlined in app.js (ICO map, currentColor, zero requests); the SVG folder assets/icons/categories/ is deployed alongside as the self-hosted source and is served 200.
No app code was changed for this deploy; this commit updates DEPLOY_RESULT.json only.
